course_name_original: UE Mathématiques pour le génie électrique
syllabus_topics: Differential operators (gradient, divergence, curl & Laplacian) and examples of their application to electric fields
Fourier series and Fourier transform, and examples of their application to signal processing
Methods for solving differential equations for 1st & 2nd order linear differential equations
Calculation of primitives for solving differential equations
Laplace transform for solving differential equations
Matrix diagonalization for solving differential equations
Application of these methods to the study of RLC circuits
Numerical solution methods for differential equations
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
